description:
FILED s419 (Fable) by the flip re-census (docs/drop-census-s419-flip-gate.md
family 7).  die_unwind.t (4) + die_except.t (2) drop every

  my $c = end { $uerr = $@; $@ = "t2\n"; };

because `end` is declared as

  { package End;
    sub DESTROY { $_[0]->() }
    sub main::end(&) { my($cleanup) = @_; return bless(sub { $cleanup->() }, "End"); } }

â a (&)-prototyped sub with a PACKAGE-QUALIFIED name, declared from inside
another package.  The block-form prototype mechanism (the generic machinery
of CLAUDE.md 9a's worked example: prototypes make trailing blocks parse as
block-form calls) keys prototypes by the name seen at declaration and never
registers `main::end` as callable `end` from main.

MECHANISM FIX, not module data: prototype extraction/registration must
normalize a qualified declared name into (package, basename) so the call-site
lookup by basename-in-current-package finds it.  Grep first for where
_extract_module_prototypes / the file-mode prototype pass store names â
there may be a second copy (feedback_check_for_a_second_copy).

Probe set: qualified decl in another package (the reproducer above);
qualified decl in the SAME package (`sub main::f(&)` from main); unqualified
decl used cross-package (`End::end { ... }` â perl does NOT apply prototypes
on qualified CALLS â inverse guard).  Blocks the announce->DIE flip.

DONE s420.  Fixed at the Environment SEAM, so every producer (v1
_register_sub_prototype, v2 _scan_segment, module extraction) and every
consumer agrees: add_prototype/get_prototype/has_prototype/get_min_params key
on the BARE name, and add_declared_sub splits a qualified name into
(package, basename) — the convention PExpr::_bareword_callable_here already
relies on.  perl agrees with BOTH halves (probed: `sub main::f(&)` from main,
and a QUALIFIED CALL `Foo::g { … }` of an unqualified declaration — the task's
guess that perl does not apply prototypes on qualified calls is WRONG).
die_unwind.t 4 -> 0 drops, die_except.t 2 -> 0 (the rows still fail: PCL has
no refcount DESTROY, a registered non-support).  Guards: 8 rows in
Pl/t/prototype-01.t including the no-prototype inverse.
Census side effect, argued in the census file: op/lexsub.t 12 -> 14 drops.
title: Package-qualified prototype declarations are invisible: sub main::end(&) => end { ... } drops (6 drops)
